d:
This one did not come with an official EN translation. Once I'm done with the Rangiku doujin, I'll probably start working on this. Also note that the Maya from DQ section did not have a text version.

Lime's Note:
Below are some brief notes on the production process.

-Rangiku Matsumoto (BLEACH)
This is a request for a nurse outfit.
Rangiku looks great in sexy costumes.

-Lafter Frankland (Mobile Suit Gundam: Iron-Blooded Orphans)
This is a request involving a shota (young boy). I drew the breasts larger as requested.

-Loly Aivirrne (BLEACH)
This character is far too charming and it would be a shame to limit them to just a minor role.
I'd like to draw a manga with her as the main character.

-Lain Iwakura (Serial experiments lain)
This is the first time I've drawn this.
I'd never drawn this type of character before, so it was a refreshing experience.

-Nightingale (Fate/GO)
This is also my first time drawing this character. I kind of figured out what kind of character he was by looking at the voice actor (lol).

-Maya (Dragon Quest 4)
It's been a really long time since I've seen Maya.
I drew this based on a request for a standing illustration.
